versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Weekly Topic Library Generator skill.
- Automatically collects and analyzes weekly public trend signals from TikTok, Reels, and Shorts for AI video creators.
- Extracts only non-copyright topic structures and generates ready-to-use prompt packs.
- Grades and filters topics for replicability, spread-odds, and compliance; outputs both Markdown and JSON files.
- Designed to ensure synthetic, compliant use—never clones original content or uses protected IP.
